blocks.text: Simon Fraser Hills home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills with a median price of $780,000 (the middle half sold between $720,000 and $922,500), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $551 per square foot, a median year built of 1972 and a median strata fee of $412 a month. 4 condos sold in Simon Fraser Hills, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Simon Fraser Hills?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 condos and townhomes listed in Simon Fraser Hills. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Simon Fraser Hills a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes had 9% (a buyers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Simon Fraser Hills from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 0 houses and 9 condos and townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills over those 5 months; condos and townhomes peaked in June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Simon Fraser Hills compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In October 2026, Simon Fraser Hills held 0.8% of the 1,309 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Simon Fraser Hills than in June?
faq.a: Listings of condos and townhomes rose from 10 in June to 11 in October 2026 (+10.0%).

faq.q: What did townhomes in Simon Fraser Hills sell for?
faq.a: 11 townhomes sold in Simon Fraser Hills between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $780,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Simon Fraser Hills?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
